Part two. FTX. In November twenty twenty-two, a news site called CoinDesk published a leaked balance sheet from Alameda Research, Sam's trading firm. Much of it was made of FTT, a token that FTX itself had created. People started asking: is the money really there? Then Changpeng Zhao, the boss of the rival exchange Binance, announced he would sell his FTT tokens. Panic. Customers rushed to pull their money out of FTX, about six billion dollars in just seventy-two hours. FTX couldn't pay. It froze withdrawals. Binance offered to buy FTX, then walked away the next day. On November eleventh, FTX filed for bankruptcy. Sam's fortune went from billions to almost nothing, in about a week. Follow for part three.
